questions.site: Where exactly do you feel it?
questions.onset: When did you first notice it?
questions.character: How would you describe what it feels like in your own words?
questions.radiation: Does it stay in that area or move anywhere else?
questions.associated: Do you notice anything else happening around the same time?
questions.timing: Is it there continuously, or does it come and go?
questions.exacerbating: Have you noticed anything that makes it worse?
questions.relieving: Have you noticed anything that makes it feel better?
questions.severity: On a scale from 0 to 10, where 0 is no pain and 10 is the strongest pain you can imagine, how strong is it at its worst?
